module Users
  class RedirectController < ::ApplicationController
    skip_before_action :authenticate_user!

    feature_category :user_management

    def redirect_from_id
      # Unauthenticated users will receive a HTTP 403 Forbidden, matching the behavior in the Users API
      if current_user
        user = User.find(user_params[:id])
        redirect_to user
      else
        render_403
      end
    end

    private

    def user_params
      params.permit(:id)
    end
  end
end


===== FILE: /workspace/gitlab/app/controllers/users/terms_controller.rb =====
# frozen_string_literal: true

module Users
  class TermsController < ApplicationController
    include InternalRedirect
    include OneTrustCSP

    skip_before_action :authenticate_user!, only: [:index]
    skip_before_action :enforce_terms!
    skip_before_action :check_password_expiration
    skip_before_action :check_two_factor_requirement
    skip_before_action :require_email

    before_action :terms

    layout 'terms'

    feature_category :user_management

    def index
      @redirect = redirect_path

      if current_user && @term.accepted_by_user?(current_user)
        flash.now[:notice] = "You have already accepted the Terms of Service as #{current_user.to_reference}"
      end
    end

    def accept
      agreement = Users::RespondToTermsService.new(current_user, viewed_term)
                    .execute(accepted: true)

      if agreement.persisted?
        redirect_to redirect_path
      else
        flash[:alert] = agreement.errors.full_messages.join(', ')
        redirect_to terms_path, redirect: redirect_path
      end
    end

    def decline
      agreement = Users::RespondToTermsService.new(current_user, viewed_term)
                    .execute(accepted: false)

      if agreement.persisted?
        sign_out(current_user)
        redirect_to root_path
      else
        flash[:alert] = agreement.errors.full_messages.join(', ')
        redirect_to terms_path, redirect: redirect_path
      end
    end

    private

    def viewed_term
      @viewed_term ||= ApplicationSetting::Term.find(safe_params[:id])
    end

    def terms
      redirect_to redirect_path unless @term = Gitlab::CurrentSettings.current_application_settings.latest_terms
    end

    def redirect_path
      redirect_to_path = safe_redirect_path(safe_params[:redirect]) || safe_redirect_path_for_url(request.referer)

      if redirect_to_path &&
          excluded_redirect_paths.none? { |excluded| redirect_to_path.include?(excluded) }
        redirect_to_path
      else
        root_path
      end
    end

    def excluded_redirect_paths
      [terms_path, new_user_session_path]
    end

    def safe_params
      params.permit(:id, :redirect)
    end
  end
end

Users::TermsController.prepend_mod


===== FILE: /workspace/gitlab/app/controllers/users/unsubscribes_controller.rb =====
# frozen_string_literal: true

module Users
  class UnsubscribesController < ApplicationController
    # Require authentication for showing the unsubscribe confirmation and performing the action
    before_action :authenticate_user!, only: [:show, :create]
    before_action :ensure_current_user_matches_email!, only: [:show, :create]

    feature_category :user_profile

    def show; end

    def create
      # @user is set in ensure_current_user_matches_email!
      @user.admin_unsubscribe!
      Notify.send_unsubscribed_notification(@user.id).deliver_later

      redirect_to new_user_session_path, notice: 'You have been unsubscribed'
    end

    protected

    # rubocop: disable CodeReuse/ActiveRecord
    def get_user
      raw = params.permit(:email)[:email]
      return unless raw.present?

      begin
        @decoded_email = Base64.urlsafe_decode64(raw.to_s)
      rescue ArgumentError
        return
      end

      # Email lookup is case-insensitive in most backends; normalize
      User.find_by(email: @decoded_email)
    end

    def ensure_current_user_matches_email!
      @user = get_user
      return render_404 unless @user

      # Ensure the authenticated actor controls this email
      unless current_user&.verified_email?(@user.email)
        return render_403
      end
    end
    # rubocop: enable CodeReuse/ActiveRecord
  end
end

# This controller implements /.well-known paths that have no better home.
#
# Other controllers also implement /.well-known/* paths. They can be
# discovered by running `rails routes | grep "well-known"`.
class WellKnownController < ApplicationController # rubocop:disable Gitlab/NamespacedClass -- No relevant product domain exists
  skip_before_action :authenticate_user!, :check_two_factor_requirement
  feature_category :compliance_management, [:security_txt]

  def security_txt
    content = Gitlab::CurrentSettings.current_application_settings.security_txt_content
    if content.present?
      render plain: content
    else
      route_not_found
    end
  end
end


===== FILE: /workspace/gitlab/app/controllers/whats_new_controller.rb =====
# frozen_string_literal: true

class WhatsNewController < ApplicationController
  include Gitlab::Utils::StrongMemoize

  skip_before_action :authenticate_user!

  before_action :check_whats_new_enabled
  before_action :check_valid_page_param, :set_pagination_headers

  feature_category :onboarding
  urgency :low

  def index
    respond_to do |format|
      format.js do
        render json: highlights.items
      end
    end
  end

  private

  def check_whats_new_enabled
    render_404 if Gitlab::CurrentSettings.current_application_settings.whats_new_variant_disabled?
  end

  def check_valid_page_param
    render_404 if current_page < 1
  end

  def current_page
    pagination_params[:page]&.to_i || 1
  end

  def highlights
    strong_memoize(:highlights) do
      ReleaseHighlight.paginated(page: current_page)
    end
  end

  def set_pagination_headers
    response.set_header('X-Next-Page', highlights.next_page)
  end
end
